Zz.bar_b_note: Pale feathered fish-bird has nice teal/white plumage but stands only about trainer height and its blob silhouette is hard to identify at small size.

Bo.bar_b_note: Naturalistic coyote with real fur read, clear silhouette, taller than the trainer and grounded faint poses carries it at style-bar finish.

Oy.bar_b_note: Smeared low-res ground, flat grey-green grade, sparse props and a hard dark tiled wall in row 1 sink it well below Palworld density and Valheim light.

Jb.bar_b_note: Warm, appealing elderly villager with readable eyes and an earthy green/brown palette that fits the settlement, though the face is more toon than the naturalistic creatures.

Eg.bar_b_note: Clear duck silhouette and good scale, but the flat blue-with-yellow-blotch pattern reads as a toy texture rather than real plumage.

Wj.bar_b_note: Spindly dragonfly is thin and low-contrast at small size and its faint end stays perched upright, so the hurt state does not read.

Iq.bar_b_note: Chrome-like body with a saturated striped sail looks synthetic rather than naturalistic, and faint mid/end are nearly identical to standing.

Tj.bar_b_note: Large newt reads and swims convincingly, but oxblood-red gill frills put faction red on a creature and the faint end balloons into a dark shapeless mass.

Ab.bar_b_note: Mossy turtle has good material and scale, but faint mid/end barely change from standing, so defeat does not read without a label.

Rp.bar_b_note: B's lightning-veined wolf approaches the Tanglevolt bar but its faint end pivots upright nose-down; A loses its material to black-and-white patches and floats above its shadow in the faint frames.

Bt.bar_b_note: Knobbly orange shell-crab has a distinctive silhouette, but salmon skin reads plasticky and the faint frames are nearly indistinguishable from standing.

Vz.bar_b_note: Mossy turtle mount works well ridden, but the faint poses do not collapse and read as standing.

Yk.bar_b_note: A's braced timber frame, roof cap and stone footing read as built, but it is still a lone pale-infilled panel in an open field, and B is a blown-out white card.

Oe.bar_b_note: Rock-plated bear-badger has a strong readable silhouette, grounded faint and a credible ridden pose at style-bar finish.

Cx.bar_b_note: Dark naturalistic wolf-bear with good fur and readable hurt/faint poses carries it, though its dark value sits close to the stage and the tail overlaps the trainer in faint frames.

top_changes.change: Author real faint animations (collapse onto side/belly, head down) for turtle, shell-crab, sail-lizard and dragonfly creatures (Ab, Vz, Bt, Iq, Wj), and fix the Rp faint pivot and material loss

Raise world finish in the Meadows sites: higher-res ground textures, grove/edge vegetation density, warmer key light with cool blue distance fog, and remove enemy banners/add site-specific debris in aftermath frames
Replace synthetic-looking creature surfaces (Iq chrome body, Eg toy blotch pattern, Bt plastic skin, Tj oxblood gills) with naturalistic scale/feather/skin materials and non-faction accent colours
